description: Blocks a profile session from writing into the engine or the installed plugin cache (scripts/guard_engine_writes.py, docs/adr-010-engine-write-guard.md), DENYs a ref-based click that resolves to an outbound-terminal control such as Send/Connect/Invite/Apply (scripts/guard_outbound_click.py, docs/deployment.md's 'outbound-click guard' section), DENYs the gmail-multi connector's send/reply/forward tools so jobsearch stays draft-only now that the connector can send (scripts/guard_mail_send.py, marketplace #213), DENYs a gmail-multi mailbox read/draft call whose account is not exactly one of this profile's own addresses that gmail-multi's registry holds, and DENYs gmail_accounts (it lists every account on the machine) — the registry is machine-wide and would otherwise return another profile's mail (scripts/guard_mail_scope.py, design-manifest-heal.md § The boundary — fails OPEN with a queryable diag row when tool_input is not visible to this build at all, and allows on the profile list with a shown systemMessage plus a diag row while the registry is still schema 1), DENYs the mail tools of whichever mail connector the profile did NOT select — gmail-multi or the claude.ai Gmail connector, matched by tool name under any server name (scripts/guard_mail_scope.py --connector, communications.mail_connector, dev #161), records that a SessionStart hook fired before any model turn so a run that dies before it can call journal.py --start still leaves proof a session existed (scripts/journal.py --fired, the 'fired' event, public #65 — loud on failure, exit 0 on every path; the hooks in this SessionStart group run in parallel, not in sequence, so this is one of several rather than a guaranteed first), runs the engine-purity term scan against this machine's own real profile as an envelope of migrate.py --hook (scripts/check_engine_purity.hook_step(), dev #411 — loud on a real hit via an asks.jsonl row, exit 0 on every path, 30s timeout), reconciles opted-in rows against the shipped channel catalog in a further migrate.py --hook envelope (channel_catalog/channel_catalog.json, dev #769 — applies only a strictly newer catalog revision to an unedited row, never touches a user's own row, writes an asks.jsonl row when both sides changed), and self-installs the connector plugins declared in plugin.json metadata.connectors at session start (scripts/ensure_connectors.py — loud on failure, exit 0 on every path).
